$comment: C17 VENDORED OFFICIAL CYCLONEDX SCHEMA CLOSURE.
The gate validates its SBOMs against the OFFICIAL schema, and an official schema fetched at
validation time is an unpinned network dependency inside a gate whose premise is that it has
none. The complete closure is vendored here and verified byte-for-byte before any schema is
compiled: bom-1.6 references jsf-0.82 and spdx, and both are resolved from this directory.
Nothing in the gate, the tests, CI or evidence generation may download a schema. A missing or
altered file fails the preflight, before Ajv sees anything.
